messages.subject: Re: remove y axis.ticks but not x?
parts:
Hi Mike,

Yes, it's only possible to remove them from both at the moment (I
didn't imagine that people would want to remove them from only one
when I was writing the code). One alternative is to specify (e.g.) +
scale_continuous(breaks = NA)

Hadley
